description: Configurations: a whole System put together, by choosing a Deployment for the root and, recursively, for each Instance of a chosen Deployment, along Instance names. Optional. Extends Kernel, Contexts and Deployment.

axioms.about: A Configuration starts with a Deployment of its System's root
axioms.formula: all c in Configuration. c.root.deployment.deployed == c.system.root

axioms.about: A choice is for an Instance exactly when it is below another
axioms.formula: all h in Choice. (some h.parent and some h.instance) or (no h.parent and no h.instance)

axioms.about: A choice is for an Instance of the Deployment chosen above it
axioms.formula: all h in Choice, p in h.parent, i in h.instance. i.deployment == p.deployment

axioms.about: A choice is of a Deployment of its Instance's Component
axioms.formula: all h in Choice, i in h.instance. h.deployment.deployed == i.of

axioms.about: Each Instance is chosen for at most once under a choice
axioms.formula: all a in Choice, b in Choice, p in a.parent. (a != b and b in p.choices) => a.instance != b.instance

axioms.about: Every choice belongs to a Configuration
axioms.formula: all h in Choice. some h.*parent.rootOf

axioms.about: No choice is below itself, eventually
axioms.formula: all h in Choice. not h in h.^parent
